title: Hedgerow On The Hill
description:
Close to the airport, this room is perfect for couples, individuals, or business travelers. Within a few miles of downtown, this lovely room has a private entrance with a patio. There is also access to our huge deck with a hot tub. Children or pets - no problem! Quick access to I-40 and I-24.

The space
There is plenty of parking at the back of the house. Please park in a marked space. Private outside entrance is on the right side of the house when you face the back.

Guest access
Guests may enjoy the deck (hot tub and chiminea). Remember that upstairs is where our family lives. You'll love the hot tub and the deck! Make sure you let us know that you want to use the hot tub. Sometimes we have it down for cleaning.

During your stay
I should be available during the day to address any needs or answer any questions. You can call/text me if I am away from the house. We may even enjoy a glass of wine with you by the hot tub.

Other things to note
We'll be glad to give you recommendations for restaurants and things to do in Nashville.

Our favorite restaurants are Istanbul Market, Ginger Thai, Rafferty's and Longhorn. These are within a few miles of the house. There is Pfunky Griddle in Berry Hill where you can cook your on pancakes. Yummm....
